question: Has TDEC been contacted to initiate the septic capacity inspection and permit process?
why_it_matters: Scope requires TDEC septic coordination (septic_requirement) and Addition rules set a 70-day minimum lead; with start at 2026-10-05 only 85 days out, any further delay eliminates the buffer and pushes the start date.

question: Has the existing main electrical service amperage been verified to support the new 100-amp subpanel without requiring a service upgrade?
why_it_matters: Addition CLAUDE.md requires an amperage check before any subpanel scope advances; subpanel_spec confirms it is in scope, and an undetected service-upgrade need would add cost and timeline not currently captured.

question: Has the truss vs. rafter decision been made for the new roof, and if trusses, have they been ordered?
why_it_matters: Roof framing method is TBD per scope (roof_framing_method); custom trusses carry a 28–42 day lead per Addition rules, so if trusses are chosen the order must be placed well before framing begins.
